units.unit_title: The Founding Myth and Early Rome
units.description: Explore the legendary origins of Rome and its initial transformation from a small settlement into a powerful republic.
objectives: Understand the story of Romulus and Remus.
Identify the key characteristics of early Roman society.

units.unit_title: The Rise of the Roman Republic
units.description: Learn about the political structure of the Roman Republic and how it expanded its influence across the Mediterranean.
objectives: Describe the roles of the Senate and Consuls.
Explain the significance of the Punic Wars.

units.unit_title: From Republic to Empire: The Rise of Caesar
units.description: Examine the internal conflicts and power struggles that led to the collapse of the Republic and the rise of powerful individuals like Julius Caesar.
objectives: Identify the causes of the Roman Civil Wars.
Understand Julius Caesar's role in the transition.

units.description: Explore the period of peace and stability known as the Pax Romana, which allowed the empire to flourish culturally and economically.
objectives: Identify key achievements during this era.

units.description: Discover the daily life of Roman citizens and the lasting impact of Roman engineering and legal systems.

units.unit_title: The Decline of the Western Empire
units.description: Analyze the internal weaknesses and external pressures that contributed to the gradual decline and eventual fall of the Western Roman Empire.
objectives: Identify key factors contributing to the decline.
Understand the significance of the year 476 AD.

units.unit_title: The Legacy of Rome: The Byzantine Empire
units.description: Learn how the Eastern Roman Empire continued to thrive for centuries after the West fell, preserving Roman traditions.
objectives: Explain the continuation of the Roman Empire in the East.
Identify key characteristics of the Byzantine Empire.
